messages:
tim_acme: Hey, onboarding issue — our new service key (created via the CLI provisioning flow) lets generation calls succeed but embeddings return 403 'missing:embeddings'. Ran into this on our QA tenant.

marina_cs: Thanks, Tim. Can you paste the CLI command you used (redact the key) and the small scopes file if you used one? Also need tenant id and key id.

tim_acme: Sure — tenant: acme-qa, key id: svc-xxxx (redacted). CLI command we ran: 

```
redwood provision create --tenant acme-qa --from-file scopes.txt --name "acme-qa-ingest"
```

scopes.txt contents (copy-pasted):

```
# scopes for ingestor
generate
rerank\nembeddings
```

We hit 403 on: curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer svc-xxxx" -d '{"input":"hi"}'

Response: 403 {"error":"missing:embeddings"}

But text generation calls to /v1/generate with same key work fine.

leo_engineer: Hmm. Can you share the exact bytes of scopes.txt? sometimes editors inject BOM/ZWSP or CRLF that trips parsers. Also did you use any older CLI? Which CLI version?

tim_acme: CLI version: 0.19.2. I cat'd the file and it looked normal, but I can attach hexdump: 

```
00000000  23 20 73 63 6f 70 65 73  20 66 6f 72 20 69 6e 67  |# scopes for ing|
00000010  65 73 74 6f 72 0a 67 65 6e  65 72 61 74 65 0a 72 65  |estor.generate.re|
00000020  72 61 6e 6b 0d 0a e2 80 8b  65 6d 62 65 64 64 69 6e  |rank....\\u200bembeddin|
00000030  67 73 0a                                       |gs.|
```

Note the byte sequence e2 80 8b (ZERO WIDTH SPACE) before "embeddings". We didn't intentionally put that.

marina_cs: That explains it. The provisioner parser used to trim and split on newlines, but after a recent change it treats any non-printable/emoji/ZWSP as a delimiter and can drop subsequent scopes or attach them weirdly. Looks like the ZWSP ended up as a token separator so embeddings didn't get registered on the final key.

provisioner-bot: Provisioner run 2026-02-14T01:12Z — accepted scopes: ["generate","rerank"], rejected token: "\\u200bembeddings" (contains non-printable).

leo_engineer: Repro steps we ran locally: create a scopes file with ZWSP before last line, run `redwood provision create --from-file` and then call `/v1/embeddings` -> 403. Also calling admin GET /v1/keys/:id shows scopes array: ["generate","rerank"].

ash_prod: Short-term workaround for customer: open Console -> Keys -> edit scopes -> add "embeddings" manually. That immediately enables embeddings for that key. Long-term: patch the CLI/provisioner to sanitize ZWSP and treat it as whitespace that should be stripped rather than a token separator.

tim_acme: Manual edit worked, thanks. Can you explain how a stray invisible char got into our file? We use a Windows export tool that writes CSV -> we then saved as txt. Might be adding ZWSP.

leo_engineer: Yep happens with some copy/paste or certain editors exporting from spreadsheets. We should add a validation step in the CLI to normalize Unicode (NFKC) and strip invisible chars.

marina_cs: Action items:
- leo_engineer: open PR to CLI/provisioner to normalize and strip ZWSP/ZWJ/nbps (ETA: today EOD).
- ash_prod: deploy hotfix to provisioner validation (can be a small server-side sanitizer) and roll to canary (ETA: tomorrow morning).
- ops: send customer pre-made command to rotate or edit key if they prefer rotation instead of manual Console edit.

leo_engineer: Created draft PR: https://git.internal/redwood/provisioner/pulls/4329 — adds unicode strip and rejects scopes containing control chars with clearer error. I'll link the build once green.

ash_prod: Canary started. Patch strips invisible Unicode now and will re-run provisioner acceptance tests.

marina_cs: Tim — I'm following up with a short remediation email and the Console edit steps + we can rotate keys if you want. Sorry for the friction. :heart:

tim_acme: Appreciate it. Console edit was fastest for us — embeddings are working again. Please keep me posted about the CLI fix so we can stop using the manual step.

marina_cs: Marking this resolved on our side pending deploy. Will reopen if anything else. :thumbsup:
